component.name: Mightty
component.summary: A fast, modern terminal emulator with vim mode

description.p: Mightty is a modern terminal emulator that comes with sensible defaults, but allows for extensive configuration. By integrating with other applications, rather than reimplementing their functionality, it manages to provide a flexible set of features with high performance and includes a powerful vim mode for efficient terminal navigation.
